evals.name: brief-before-work
evals.prompt: Make a music video for song.mp3. Moody, nocturnal, film grain. Render the dancer at 1080p.
evals.expected_output: One plain message with the brief questions and their defaults, then a stop.
expectations: Asks the brief questions in one message, each with a default, including the language the lyrics are sung in
Does not generate clips, download footage or render before an explicit go
Tells the user that the engine scripts are fetched from the repository at a pinned commit
Does not use a multiple-choice question UI

evals.name: archive-only-through-concept
evals.prompt: Archive footage only, no AI. It's a 124 BPM house track about a city at night. Moody, nocturnal, film grain. Use your defaults for everything else and go.
evals.expected_output: Setup, song analysis with a grid check, then three concepts proposed before any footage is downloaded.
expectations: Every command that uses $ENGINE or $ENGINE_REV sets them in the same command
Writes mv/scripts/ENGINE_REV and mv/NOTES.md with the brief in the user's words
Runs gridcheck.py after analyze_song.py and gives the user mv/review/grid_check.wav to listen to
Proposes three concepts with a recommendation before searching or downloading archive footage
No concept uses a HUD frame, spectrum bars, a film-leader countdown or another listed habit
No concept reframes or restyles the whole picture for longer than a beat or two

evals.name: edit-and-render-checks
evals.prompt: Concept B. Go ahead and cut it and render.
files: a project after Phase 4, with archive films in mv/archive and codes.json
evals.expected_output: A chapter table, an EDL without unexplained warnings, still sheets judged against the brief, then the full render and QC.
expectations: Shows a chapter table with footage, shot sizes and grade per section before writing the EDL
Defines this video's grades in look.py before running edl.py
Each section draws on its own few sources; no section rotates through every film
Looks at the --edl contact sheets and the still sheets before the full render
The end card credits every source whose license asks for it
Runs beatsheet.py only after the full render exists, and qc.py on the result
The report gives path, duration, size, the credited sources and any items without a license field

evals.name: remake-keeps-original-sync
evals.prompt: The singer looks slightly out of sync in the second chorus. Can you fix the lip sync?
files: a remake project whose song is the original video's own soundtrack, singer shots at sync=0
evals.expected_output: A check that the shots sit at their original times and a question about the original; no offset.
expectations: Checks that the singer's shots play at their own song times (sync=0)
Asks whether the original video plays in sync for the user
Does not measure or save an av_offset and does not shift any shot

evals.name: resume-an-existing-project
evals.prompt: Pick the video for this track back up: swap the second drop's footage for the harbour film and give me a vertical hook from that drop.
files: an existing mv/ project with NOTES.md and an older mv/scripts/ENGINE_REV
evals.expected_output: Notes read first, the engine difference handled, the EDL changed, a bar-locked 9:16 hook rendered.
expectations: Reads mv/NOTES.md before changing anything
Compares mv/scripts/ENGINE_REV with the skill's ENGINE_REV and follows the engine update steps, keeping edl.py, look.py and fx.py
Re-runs edl.py and resolves or explains its warnings
Renders the hook with --size 1080x1920 and --start/--end on bar lines, starting on a full-frame shot
Updates mv/NOTES.md with what changed
